Organic-only reach

Sales follow your posting

Your masterclass and courses are there every day, but only people who already follow you see them. The day you post less, fewer people find them.

DM keyword

Every lead needs a conversation

“DM START” works, but it means every lead is a manual chat. It caps how many people you and your team can handle, and it doesn’t tell you who can afford mentorship.

No buyer-to-applicant path

Course buyers stop at the course

The application is there, but nothing walks a busy high earner from “bought a course” to “ready to apply” on autopilot, with a bump and upsell that show who is serious.

Your products are ready to sell. What’s missing is daily ad traffic into them, and a path that turns buyers into qualified mentorship applicants.

Questions

Before you grab the kit

Do I need to own a property already?

No. The kit works whether you’re planning your first rental or tightening up the ones you have.

Is this tax advice?

No. It’s educational content to help you prepare for a conversation with a qualified tax professional about your own situation.

How long does it take?

The video training is 60 minutes. Most of the templates you can copy into your own systems the same day.

Why is it only $27?

Because the first step should be easy. Use the kit, see the difference, and decide afterwards if you want to go deeper with me.

Educational content, not tax or financial advice. Results depend on your market, property and effort.

Ad creatives · Video scripts

Ad scripts: talking to camera

Shot in your kitchen, same setup as your reels. 30 to 45 seconds each.

Script 1 · “The 11pm message”

Hook (0 to 3s)

“If your Airbnb texts you at 11pm, it isn’t passive. It’s a second job.”

Body

“Most busy professionals start a rental and end up as the property manager. The fix isn’t hiring someone straight away. It’s putting systems in first: automated guest messages, a turnover checklist your cleaner follows, and one tool that holds it together.”

CTA

“I put all of it in the Hands-Off Host Kit. It’s $27. Tap Learn more.”

Shot: talking to camera in the kitchen, phone buzzing on the counter as the hook lands.

Script 2 · “Systems before staff”

Hook (0 to 3s)

“Before you hire a property manager, do this.”

Body

“Write down every task your rental needs in a week. Then sort it: what can be automated, what can be a checklist, and what really needs a person. You’ll find most of it doesn’t need you, or a manager.”

CTA

“The Hands-Off Host Kit walks you through it, with the templates done for you. $27, instant access. Tap Learn more.”

Shot: talking to camera, on-screen text “systems before staff” with “staff” highlighted in red.

Script 3 · “Ask your CPA this”

Hook (0 to 3s)

“High earners, here’s what to ask your CPA about short-term rentals.”

Body

“Not every tax professional works with short-term rentals. Before you hire one, ask how many STR clients they have and how they’d look at your situation. I put my full question list in a kit, along with the systems that keep a rental running without you. This is education, not tax advice.”

CTA

“Grab the Hands-Off Host Kit for $27. Tap Learn more.”

Shot: talking to camera, cut to a close-up of the checklist page. Add “Educational content, not tax advice” on screen.
